title: Systems Online
description: Initialize your first spacecraft mission configuration in the workspace.

title: Flight Certified
description: Balance mass, power, pointing, thermal, and budget to satisfy all pre-flight constraints.
unlockRequirement: Clear all engineering errors in design advisor

title: We Have Liftoff
description: Initiate your first launch sequence from the launch pad.

title: Orbital Velocity
description: Successfully insert payload into target orbit with zero launch vehicle anomalies.

title: First Light
description: Successfully complete your first flight operations mission with positive science return.

title: Penny Pincher
description: Deliver a fully certified mission under 60% of the authorized budget cap.
unlockRequirement: Complete mission spending <= 60% of budget cap

title: Frugal Architect
description: Deliver a fully certified mission under 75% of the authorized budget cap.
unlockRequirement: Complete mission spending <= 75% of budget cap

title: Featherweight Class
description: Design an operational spacecraft with dry mass under 150 kg.
unlockRequirement: Dry mass < 150 kg with nominal rating

title: Lean Machine
description: Achieve Grade A or higher with less than 20% mass margin remaining on the bus.
unlockRequirement: Grade A+ with tight mass budget

title: Zero Waste Margin
description: Complete mission with less than 5% delta-v excess beyond nominal requirements.

title: Last Drop
description: Conclude operational flight lifetime with less than 2% propellant remaining in tanks.

title: Sun God
description: Generate more than 4x peak orbital power demand with high-efficiency arrays.

title: Absolute Chill
description: Equip and sustain active cryogenic focal plane cooling (65-80K) for infrared science.
unlockRequirement: Fly active cryocooler with infrared detector

title: Laser Precision
description: Install star trackers and reaction wheels achieving 0.005° or finer pointing accuracy.

title: Broadband Constellation
description: Equip high-throughput Ka-band transponders providing > 100 Mbps data downlink.

title: Flagship Observatory
description: Launch a spacecraft carrying at least 3 distinct scientific instrument payloads.

title: Rad-Toughened
description: Construct a bus rated for over 100 krad total ionizing dose for deep-space survivability.

title: Eclipse Survivor
description: Maintain battery depth of discharge under 60% during a full maximum orbital eclipse.

title: Storm Rider
description: Survive a severe coronal mass ejection (CME) solar storm without loss of science telemetry.
unlockRequirement: Survive solar storm anomaly with zero science loss

title: Thermal Equilibrium
description: Balance internal dissipation and multi-layer insulation to keep bus within 15°C to 25°C.

title: Hot Rock
description: Survive extreme thermal radiation fluxes exceeding 2600 W/m² in inner solar orbits.

title: Fail-Safe Architecture
description: Install radiation-hardened dual redundant flight computers and backup reaction wheels.

title: Long Haul
description: Certify and simulate a deep-space spacecraft with projected mission lifetime of 10+ years.

title: Low Earth Sentry
description: Complete Earth Watch in 500 km polar orbit with > 90% science return.
unlockRequirement: Complete Earth Watch scenario with Grade A or S

title: Frost and Ash
description: Deploy multispectral thermal imagers in Sun-Synchronous Orbit to detect wildfire signatures.
unlockRequirement: Complete Fire & Ice wildfire monitor scenario

title: Clarke Ring Stationary
description: Insert high-capacity communications transponders into 35,786 km geostationary orbit.

title: Lagrangian Gatekeeper
description: Navigate to the Sun-Earth L1 halo orbit 1.5 million kilometers sunward.
unlockRequirement: Complete Space Weather Sentinel at L1

title: Worlds Unknown
description: Place wide-field transit photometers in high Earth orbit to discover habitable exoplanets.

title: Cislunar Pioneer
description: Execute Translunar Injection (TLI) and enter a stable low lunar mapping orbit.

title: Martian Relay
description: Transfer across interplanetary space and establish telecommunications relay at Mars.

title: Subsurface Abyss
description: Navigate the Jupiter radiation belts to conduct ice-penetrating radar scans of Europa.

title: Academy Honours
description: Graduate the Space Academy by completing all 6 interactive core aerospace lessons.

title: Codex Scholar
description: Consult aerospace engineering explanations across 10 distinct mission parameters.

title: Curious Mind
description: Inspect the NASA real-world flight twin comparisons for 3 different missions.
unlockRequirement: Review NASA flight twins in debrief

title: Many Roads
description: Complete the same scenario with 3 completely distinct valid architectural designs.
unlockRequirement: Fly 3 unique architectures for one scenario

title: Go For Throttle Up
description: Make an active flight controller intervention to resolve an on-orbit operational anomaly.

title: Perfect Insertion
description: Complete Stage 4 orbital deployment with a 98%+ nominal launch reliability score.

title: Hands Off the Console
description: Complete full operations simulation with CAPCOM Autopilot autonomously executing SOPs.
unlockRequirement: Fly mission with CAPCOM Autopilot enabled

title: First Step Out
description: Complete Act I Chapter 1 of the Meridian Space Authority campaign.

title: Earthbound No More
description: Conclude Act I of the campaign and receive authorization for the lunar program.

title: Exceptional Flight
description: Achieve a composite debrief score of 90 or higher (Grade A).

title: S-Tier Flight Director
description: Achieve a flawless 95+ composite debrief score (Grade S) across all five flight metrics.

title: Chief Aerospace Architect
description: Attain the highest operational rank of Chief Engineer with 22,000+ career XP.

title: Open Skies
description: Design and launch an unconstrained experimental spacecraft in Sandbox mode.
